headline: How did Real Madrid crush RB Leipzig in the Champions League?
standfirst: Real Madrid maintained their flawless European campaign with a dominant 4-1 victory over RB Leipzig, powered by standout goals from Kylian Mbappé and Bernardo Silva.
keyPoints: Real Madrid defeated RB Leipzig 4-1 to secure their third consecutive Champions League win.
Bernardo Silva opened the scoring with his first goal for Madrid since joining from Manchester City.
Kylian Mbappé scored his twelfth goal of the season with a brilliant curling effort.
Yan Diomande sealed the emphatic victory late on with a powerful volley into the top corner.

sections.heading: How did the match unfold in Madrid?
paragraphs: Real Madrid put on a commanding display at home, sweeping aside German side RB Leipzig with a comfortable 4-1 scoreline. The victory keeps the record 15-time European champions sitting pretty with a perfect record in the newly formatted league phase of the Champions League.

Despite a relatively tight and low-key first half, Bernardo Silva broke the deadlock just before the break by tapping in from close range. It marked a special milestone for the midfielder, who notched his very first goal for the Spanish giants since arriving from Manchester City during the summer transfer window.

sections.heading: Who were the standout goalscorers on the night?
paragraphs: Arda Guler doubled Madrid's advantage shortly after the interval, turning home a neat ball across the face of goal. Kylian Mbappé then got in on the act, continuing his blistering run of form by bending a sublime shot past the goalkeeper to make it three.

Although Leipzig managed a brief consolation goal through Tidiam Gomis, substitute Yan Diomande ensured Madrid finished in style. The young winger unleashed a ferocious volley into the top corner to cap off a brilliant night for Jose Mourinho's squad.

sections.heading: What does this mean for Mbappé and Madrid's season?
paragraphs: For Kylian Mbappé, the match was another chance to showcase his world-class credentials ahead of the upcoming Ballon d'Or ceremony. The French superstar has now netted in every single Champions League fixture this season, bringing his impressive tally to 12 goals in just 12 matches.

The comprehensive win also provides a massive morale boost for Madrid as they head into a crucial domestic fixture against fierce rivals Barcelona. With three wins from three in Europe, Mourinho's men are well on track to secure a coveted spot in the top eight of the league phase.

highlight: Kylian Mbappe bent home a third before Tidiam Gomis pulled one back for the German side and Diomande rammed a volley into the top corner to cap Madrid's triumph late on.

timeline.what: Real Madrid defeat RB Leipzig 4-1 to claim their third consecutive win in the Champions League league phase.

socialSummary: Real Madrid cruised to a 4-1 Champions League victory over RB Leipzig, driven by goals from Bernardo Silva, Kylian Mbappé, and Yan Diomande.
